title: Warm Norwegian Mozzarella Casserole
description: A traditional Norwegian dish featuring mozzarella, perfect for a hangover cure, made in a copper pot with katsuramuki-cut ingredients and no onion or garlic.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Grease the copper pot with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the copper pot and cook over medium heat until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the katsuramuki-cut zucchini and carrots to the copper pot and cook until they are tender.
Stir in the tomato sauce, salt, and black pepper, and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture cook while you prepare the mozzarella cheese.
In a large bowl, combine the shredded mozzarella cheese and chopped parsley.
Add the cheese mixture to the copper pot and stir until the cheese is melted and the mixture is well combined.
Transfer the copper pot to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes, or until the cheese is golden brown and bubbly.
Remove the copper pot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
